_meta.project: MiniRTS — a TypeScript / Phaser 3 RTS in the style of Westwood's 1990s Command & Conquer games. 8 tribes, 390×844 portrait viewport on a 2000×2000 world, single-player vs AI.
_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for every audible event in the game. The original Red Alert wavs in ./sounds/ are copyrighted; the library in ./output/ is the replacement that the game should load. Every sound has been auditioned and accepted.
_meta.audio_production_pipeline: Each output entry has a `type` that determined how it was produced. Types: 'sfx' (Freesound.org sample; the entry preserves `query`+`duration_*`+optional `username` for reproducibility, or a local `source` path that overrides Freesound search and points at a file already on disk). 'tts' (ElevenLabs TTS — the `text` is spoken by the `voice` resolved from tts_voices, then post-processed by radiofy.py through a bandpass+compression+crackle chain to sound like a military radio). 'alias' (a literal copy of another event's first output; `alias_of` names the source event id). All wavs are mono 22.05 kHz pcm_s16le and loudness-normalized to ~-16 LUFS for consistent in-game playback levels.
_meta.code_wiring_instructions: INTEGRATION STEPS for the game agent: (1) The library lives in ./output/<category>/<filename>.wav — 133 wavs across 9 category subdirs (weapon, event, ui, alert, game_state, voice, tribe_voice, tribe_super, unit_special). Either point Phaser preloads at output/<category>/ directly, or rsync the contents into ./sounds/ (overwriting the legacy Red Alert wavs). (2) For each event, outputs[].file is the authoritative game-facing path. If an event has multiple outputs they are random variants — pick one per playback. (3) The `usage` field describes the SoundSystem hook. For status:'existing' events the method already exists; refresh its filename array. For status:'proposed' events follow `usage` — typical pattern: add a new SoundSystem.play<Foo> method, register the wav(s) in the preload list, and call it at the location named in `usage`. (4) For category:tribe_voice and tribe_super, gate playback on the player faction id; these are per-tribe overrides for the generic commander / super-weapon sounds. (5) Voice files have already been radio-treated; the raw TTS in ./voice/ is intermediate and is NOT needed by the game. Do not bundle ./voice/. (6) Five SFX outputs (4 explosions + lightning_zap) carry a `source` field pointing at the legacy ./sounds/ wav. These are temporary placeholders using the still-copyrighted Red Alert audio — they sound right but should be swapped before any public release. (7) ./output/attribution.json is the per-sample Freesound credit ledger. ./output/CREDITS.md is the human-readable summary. Bundle CREDITS.md (at minimum the CC-BY entries) before shipping. One sample is CC-BY-NC (non-commercial only) — see CREDITS.md, replace it for commercial release. (8) After wiring, run `npx tsc --noEmit`; anything left in ./sounds/ that doesn't appear as an outputs[].file in this manifest is an unused Red Alert original and can be deleted.

schema.status: 'existing' = was in the game already (has a `legacy` Red Alert filename); 'proposed' = new audible event.
schema.category: weapon | event | voice | ui | alert | game_state | tribe_super | tribe_voice | unit_special — also names the output subdir.
schema.usage: where the sound plays in the game code / which SoundSystem hook owns it.
schema.outputs: list of files; multiple entries are random variants the game picks between.
schema.outputs[*].legacy: name of the original Red Alert wav this output replaces (filename mapping for the rename step).
schema.outputs[*].query: sfx only: Freesound search keywords used (kept for reproducibility).
schema.outputs[*].username: sfx only: Freesound uploader filter used (when present).
schema.outputs[*].source: sfx only: local source file to copy (overrides Freesound; used by the 5 RA placeholders).
schema.outputs[*].voice: tts only: key into tts_voices map.
schema.outputs[*].alias_of: alias only: another event id whose first output is copied into this file.

style_guide: Sound aesthetic — early-1990s Westwood Studios Command & Conquer: Red Alert. Punchy, slightly distorted radio-compressed voice lines (radio operator / field commander barking through a tinny radio), explosive booms with prominent low-end and a brief tail of debris rumble, weapons that sound mechanical and weighty. UI clicks should feel like brass-and-CRT-era console blips. Modern fidelity is fine, but the timbre should stay deliberately 1990s in spirit — slight grit, dry recordings, no modern hyperreal polish.

TROOPER_M_GRUFF.description: Gruff older male — gravelly, blunt, a sergeant who's seen too many tours. Default 'rough soldier' bark.

TROOPER_M_DEEP.description: Deep American male, low and commanding. The radio-baritone trooper.

TROOPER_M_AUSSIE.description: Australian male, weathered and lively. Adds non-American variety to the pool.

TROOPER_F_STRONG.description: Strong young female — sharp, confident, not soft. Soldier delivery.

TROOPER_F_RADIO.description: Crisp female radio operator — calm, procedural, the voice on the other end of the comm channel.

FORGEBORN_FOREMAN.description: Steel-mill foreman, older male, low and gravelly with industrial weight. The Forgeborn tribal voice.

AURUM_TEMPLAR.description: British male, solemn and ceremonial, paladin/templar diction. The Aurum tribal voice — measured rather than shouted.

SKYFORCE_PILOT.description: Crisp middle-aged male pilot voice, radio-procedural cadence. The Skyforce tribal voice.

BLOODHOUND_ZEALOT.description: Raspy male zealot, almost feral, shouting. The Bloodhound tribal voice.

THORNWOOD_SPIRIT.description: Warm female with a hushed, almost whispered delivery. The Thornwood forest-spirit voice.

WRAITH_WHISPER.description: Young male, conspiratorial whisper, sibilant and dry. The Wraith tribal voice — uncomfortably intimate.

VEXKIN_CHITTER.description: Well-rounded male, used here for clipped chitter-like deliveries with sibilant edges. The Vexkin tribal voice — meant to feel barely human.

SYMBIONT_HIVE.description: Soft female, used for wet biological hive-mind deliveries. The Symbiont tribal voice — single voice now, can be doubled in post for the layered feel.

events.description: Single sharp infantry rifle crack, dry muzzle pop with brief metallic ping, almost no tail.
events.usage: SoundSystem.playFireSound('rifle') — fired per shot by infantry units in CombatSystem.fireProjectile.

events.description: Stuttering belt-fed machine-gun burst, several rapid metallic cracks with a slight echo.
events.usage: SoundSystem.playFireSound('mg') — machine-gun infantry / light-MG turrets in CombatSystem.fireProjectile.

events.description: Fortified bunker-mounted gun firing from inside a concrete embrasure — muffled crack with low boxed-in resonance.
events.usage: SoundSystem.playFireSound('pillbox') — pillbox-style static defenses when engaging.

events.description: Tank main cannon firing — deep low boom with a metallic crack on the attack and a short ringing decay; shared by tanks (full volume) and defensive turrets (attenuated).
events.usage: SoundSystem.playFireSound('cannon' / 'turret') — Forgeborn tanks and most defensive turrets in CombatSystem.fireProjectile.

events.description: Heavy siege artillery / mortar firing — very deep concussive boom with a thump that drops into a long rumble.
events.usage: SoundSystem.playFireSound('heavyCannon') — Forgeborn Siege Works artillery in CombatSystem.fireProjectile.

events.description: Suppressed sniper rifle — soft muffled pop with a thin metallic action click, almost no report.
events.usage: SoundSystem.playFireSound('silenced') — stealth/scout units (e.g. Wraith snipers) in CombatSystem.fireProjectile.

events.description: Infantry crushed under a vehicle tread — wet sickly squish with a low bone crunch and a brief metallic scrape.
events.usage: SoundSystem.playSquish — CombatSystem when a vehicle drives over and crushes an infantry unit.

events.description: Small unit-destruction explosion — sharp crack, brief fireball whoosh, short low rumble tail.
events.usage: SoundSystem.playExplosionSmall — CombatSystem when a non-infantry unit dies.

events.description: Large building-destruction explosion — heavy concussive boom with deep low thump, mid-range fire crackle, long debris-rumble tail.
events.usage: SoundSystem.playExplosionLarge — GameScene when a building is destroyed.

events.description: Construction begins — dirt and dust settling, wooden / metal scaffold staked into the ground, brief mechanical clank.
events.usage: SoundSystem.playBuild — GameScene.spawnBuilding.

events.description: Construction finished — confident affirmative chime, two-tone rising mechanical ping with a faint warm hum, satisfying completion cue.
events.usage: SoundSystem.playBuildComplete — fires 900 ms after building_placement.

events.description: Two organic units merging — warbling chrono-style warp, ascending shimmer with a wet biological undertone, brief and otherworldly.
events.usage: SoundSystem.playFusion — GameScene when two Symbiont units merge.

events.description: Harvester unloads crystals at the refinery — bright cash-register-style chime with a clean metallic clink, rewarding.
events.usage: SoundSystem.playCrystalDeposit — fires when any harvester deposits crystals.

events.description: Player level-up fanfare — ascending four-note chime, clean bell-like tones, brief and triumphant.
events.usage: SoundSystem.playLevelUp — GameScene when the player gains a perk level.

events.description: Soft healing chime — gentle warm sine tone with a brief bell-like shimmer, quiet and reassuring, very short tail.
events.usage: SoundSystem.playHeal — clinic / healing radius touches a unit; also Aurum Sanctuary Pulse super via playSuperEcho.

events.description: UI button click — crisp short menu blip, slight digital chirp, no tail.
events.usage: SoundSystem.playClick — every button press in MenuScene and most in-game HUD buttons.

events.description: Victory chime — ascending major-key four-note fanfare, bright sine tones with a hint of brass, triumphant.
events.usage: SoundSystem.playVictory — GameScene.endMatch on win.

events.description: Defeat / mission failed — descending minor-key tones, low mournful warble like a radar powering down into silence.
events.usage: SoundSystem.playDefeat — GameScene.endMatch on loss.

events.description: Commander voice line — short shouted military bark acknowledging a move order, gritty radio-compressed delivery.
events.usage: SoundSystem.playCommanderMove — issued on move/rally orders, throttled ~once / 2.2 s. Game picks one variant at random.

events.description: Engineer voice line — enthusiastic blue-collar shout acknowledging a build order, radio-compressed.
events.usage: SoundSystem.playCommanderBuild — GameScene.spawnBuilding, throttled ~once / 3 s.

events.description: Infantry soldier dying — non-verbal pained male death scream / grunt / choked gasp, several variants.
events.usage: SoundSystem.playUnitDeath — CombatSystem on infantry death. Game picks a variant at random.

events.description: High-voltage electrical arc — sharp crackling snap, quick electric whip of static, fizzling decay.
events.usage: SoundSystem.playLightning — tesla-coil attacks, chain lightning, Skyforce Lightning Storm super.

events.description: Kamikaze landmine-style detonation — sharp crack, tight high-pressure pop, brief metallic shrapnel rattle, no long tail.
events.usage: SoundSystem.playReaverImpact — Bloodhound Reaver suicide impact.

events.description: Entire faction destroyed — heavy structural crumble, walls collapsing, deep thump and long debris rumble.
events.usage: SoundSystem.playTribeEliminated — entire faction loses its last building / commander.

events.description: Deep-freeze area pulse — ascending icy shimmer, crystalline whoosh with a faint sub-zero crack, otherworldly cold.
events.usage: SoundSystem.playFrost — Thornwood Deep Freeze super impact.

events.description: Fiery splash-damage detonation — whooshing fireball, mid-range crackle with a low thump, brief sustained heat hiss.
events.usage: SoundSystem.playSplash — splash projectiles (artillery, rocket, AoE) and several super-weapons.

events.description: Radar / scanner powering on — rising mechanical whine with a confirming digital chirp, electronics warming up.
events.usage: SoundSystem.playRadarOn — GameScene when the player finishes a radar / minimap structure.

events.description: Base-under-attack siren — buzzing two-tone alarm, urgent and slightly distorted.
events.usage: SoundSystem.playAlert — any player building takes damage (internal cooldown).

events.description: Match launch cue — short bright digital bleep or rising radar power-on chirp, anticipatory.
events.usage: SoundSystem.playGameStart — MenuScene 'Launch' click.

events.description: Forgeborn Tactical Nuke detonation — distinctly atomic, longer and heavier than the generic large explosion.
events.usage: Add SoundSystem.playNukeImpact; call instead of playExplosionLarge at the Forgeborn nuke super-weapon impact site in CombatSystem.

events.description: Aurum Sanctuary Pulse — wide cathedral organ chord swelling outward with choir 'aaah', sacred and protective.
events.usage: Replace playHeal in the Aurum super-weapon dispatch path.

events.description: Skyforce Lightning Storm — extended thunderclap with multiple staggered strikes, deep rolling thunder.
events.usage: Replace playLightning in the Skyforce super-weapon dispatch.

events.description: Bloodhound Blood Frenzy — howling and snarling hounds layered with a slow heavy heartbeat, wet meaty undertone.
events.usage: Replace the current generic SFX in the Bloodhound super-weapon dispatch.

events.description: Thornwood Deep Freeze — ascending arctic wind into vast crystalline ice cracking, faint distant wolf howl.
events.usage: Replace playFrost in the Thornwood super-weapon dispatch.

events.description: Wraith Poison Cloud — long sinister snake-hiss with faint sickly bubbling, slowly fading.
events.usage: Replace the generic splash sound in the Wraith super-weapon dispatch.

events.description: Vexkin Wasp Storm — overwhelming high-frequency wing buzz mounting in pitch, faint angry chitters, sharp collective snap.
events.usage: Replace the generic splash sound used for the Vexkin super-weapon.

events.description: Symbiont Genome Burst — wet biological heart-squeeze pulse with rising tonal tissue-growth shimmer.
events.usage: Replace the generic heal/splash sound in the Symbiont super-weapon dispatch.

events.description: Forgeborn tribe voice pack — gruff foundry-foreman voice, blue-collar steel-mill cadence.
events.usage: Per-tribe override of commander_move_ack / commander_build_ack when the player is Forgeborn.

events.description: Aurum tribe voice pack — solemn male templar / paladin voice, slow and ceremonial.
events.usage: Per-tribe override when the player is Aurum.

events.description: Skyforce tribe voice pack — sharp clipped pilot voice with radio cadence.
events.usage: Per-tribe override when the player is Skyforce.

events.description: Bloodhound tribe voice pack — snarling zealot, almost feral.
events.usage: Per-tribe override when the player is Bloodhound.

events.description: Thornwood tribe voice pack — whispering forest-spirit voice, reverberant.
events.usage: Per-tribe override when the player is Thornwood.

events.description: Wraith tribe voice pack — hushed conspiratorial whisper, sibilant.
events.usage: Per-tribe override when the player is Wraith.

events.description: Vexkin tribe voice pack — chittering near-words, sibilant insect-like.
events.usage: Per-tribe override when the player is Vexkin.

events.description: Symbiont tribe voice pack — wet biological hive-mind delivery.
events.usage: Per-tribe override when the player is Symbiont.

events.description: Super-weapon recharged / ready to fire — authoritative two-tone digital chirp + ready beep.
events.usage: Add playSuperWeaponReady; fire once when any super-weapon cooldown completes for the player.

events.description: Super-weapon arming — rising capacitor whine ending in a sharp click.
events.usage: Add playSuperWeaponArming; fire when player clicks the super-weapon button to enter target-selection.

events.description: Single-building distress alert — softer than the base klaxon, three-pulse bleep over a low warning tone.
events.usage: Add playBuildingDamage (spatial). Replace per-building playAlert calls; keep the base klaxon for commander-on-fire / multi-building emergencies only.

events.description: Unit / faction selection blip — distinct from ui_click; lower pitched mechanical click-clack like flipping a toggle.
events.usage: Add playSelect; replace ui_click in spectator follow-faction picker, minimap click, world selection.

events.description: Build / action denied — short descending two-note negative buzz, the universal 'no' cue.
events.usage: Add playDenied; fire when an action is rejected (insufficient crystals, cap reached, invalid placement).

events.description: Tutorial / objective dialog appears — soft warm rising chime, friendly and instructional.
events.usage: Add playTutorialDialog; fire from TutorialController.showDialog.

events.description: Tutorial objective completed — short bright ascending two-note chime, satisfying.
events.usage: Add playTutorialAdvance; fire on tutorial phase transitions.

events.description: Spectator speed-toggle changed — quick rising digital chirp.
events.usage: Wire into HUD.advanceSpectatorSpeedToggle (currently silent).

events.description: Reinforcement spawn / bonus units arrived — radio chirp + brief energetic fanfare snippet.
events.usage: Add playReinforcements; wire to Reinforcements upgrade spawn dispatch.

events.description: First contact with an enemy tribe — brief dramatic sting with faint identifier chord, ominous.
events.usage: Add playFirstContact; fire once per enemy tribe per match when first revealed by fog-of-war.

events.description: Minimap ping / generic notification blip — sonar-style 'tink' with ringing tail.
events.usage: Add playPing; generic ping for minimap events that don't deserve a klaxon.

events.description: Harvester loading at a crystal field — faint mechanical clatter with crystalline tinkle.
events.usage: Add playHarvesterPickup (spatial, throttled). Wire at start of crystal-pickup state.

events.description: Crystal cluster exhausted — descending shimmer with final quiet 'tink'.
events.usage: Add playCrystalDepleted (spatial); wire at crystal-node fillFraction-hits-zero.

events.description: Crystal cluster regrown — gentle ascending crystalline chime, optimistic.
events.usage: Add playCrystalRespawn (spatial); inverse of depleted.

events.description: Wraith unit materialising — reverse-reverb whoosh ending in a sharp tonal pop.
events.usage: Wire into Wraith stealth-system state transition (becoming visible).

events.description: Wraith unit fading to stealth — forward whoosh into silence with faint sibilant tail.
events.usage: Wire into Wraith stealth-system (returning to stealth).

events.description: Bloodhound Reaver charging fuse — rising mechanical-fleshy whine with quickening heartbeat.
events.usage: Wire into the Reaver AI 'committed' state, giving the defender a brief audio warning.

events.description: Vexkin swarmlings flying overhead — high-density wing-buzz Doppler whoosh.
events.usage: Wire into a passive check in GameScene — tight group of Vexkin swarmlings passing near the camera (throttled).

events.description: Symbiont siphon traveling pulse — soft wet 'thoop' with faint tonal rise. Must not become annoying.
events.usage: Wire (spatial, heavily throttled per-source) into siphon-visual update in GameScene.

events.description: Commander critically wounded — solemn slow pulsing tone with low heartbeat thump.
events.usage: Add playCommanderLowHealth; fire when player's commander drops below 25% health (possibly looped at low volume).
